question: What invocation is to be uttered on the ear in the continuing nyāsa sequence?
premises: An utterance is prescribed on the ear.
The invocation is addressed to Saṃkarṣaṇa as the heart-lotus principle.
inference: On the ear one should utter the invocation to Saṃkarṣaṇa, the heart-lotus principle.
plain_english: On the ear one should utter the invocation to Saṃkarṣaṇa, the principle of the heart-lotus.
